description: SpinDoctor 3.1.2 quantum-circuit SIMULATOR as an Agent Plugins package, with an optional Windows launcher (the 'companion') that finds Python for the MCP server: q.* scripts (1-298 logical qubits), 241 presets, q.folder, theory testing, TXT/PDF/JSON/CSV reports.
